assumptions: Consumes existing V1 MODEL_DERIVED_SIMULATION planetology state read-only inside explicit finite mass, radius, age, climate-cell, constituent, exact-ledger, query-context and history bounds.
Input world identity and exact modeled composition/interior closures are validated fail-closed before downstream context is emitted.

The same deterministic non-cryptographic model digest is emitted by rendering, inspection, environment, ecology, gameplay and surface packets so consumers can prove state coherence without confusing the digest with scientific authentication.
V2X-15 research is limitation and falsification lineage only; its RESEARCH_ONLY kernels are not silently promoted into this shipping provider.
limitations: No calibrated equation of state, mass-radius retrieval, atmospheric abundance retrieval, photochemistry, general circulation model or weather forecast is claimed.
Geodynamic and volcanic outputs are reduced potentials only; resolved plate tectonics and tectonic history remain unsupported.
Optional XUV history changes contextual escape weighting only; no escape rate or integrated physical mass loss is inferred.
Gravity and escape diagnostics preserve V1 modeled quantities and explicitly report when escape velocity is absent; they are not measurements.
Volatile reservoir units preserve exact bounded internal model accounting but are not kilograms, moles, ocean depth or observed inventory.
Normalized planetary causal attribution is explanatory weighting and must not be interpreted as conserved energy, conserved mass or causal identification.
V2X-06 surface integration withholds water/ice area and surface-owned erosion/aridity/impact inputs; volatile inventory is never converted into area.
Life and Civilization packets expose bounded eligibility constraints only and never decide biological habitability or civilization viability.
Rendering appearance cues are PRESENTATION_ONLY values derived from MODEL_DERIVED_SIMULATION state and do not become canonical planetary truth.

fidelity.validity: Known V1 terrestrial, volatile-rich, sub-Neptune, ice-giant and gas-giant modeled states inside the explicit V2X-05 applicability and integrity envelope.
fidelity.resolution: One modeled world; at most 24 climate cells, 6 constituent families, 64 optional XUV-history samples and 6 bounded consumer contexts per evaluation surface.
fidelity.uncertainty: Deterministic scenario depth only; unsupported physics remains explicitly UNSUPPORTED or RESEARCH_REQUIRED rather than being filled with calibrated-looking precision.
